Lockout Gate — Privacy & Help
Updated 19 October 2026

App selections, habits, usage counters and background pictures are stored on your phone. Keep Me Out connects to your configured server using HTTPS. It sends a device identifier, authentication credential, requested duration and early-exit requests. The server stores the lock end time. An admin key is sent only when you enter it to end a lock; the app does not save that key. No ads, purchases, remote AI or analytics are included.

Accessibility supports foreground app blocking. The permission disclosure explains what this build can read. Usage Access measures selected-app break time. Two pauses are allowed per calendar month; resuming does not refund a pause. Permanent selections cannot be unchecked inside this app. Keep Me Out allows calls, WhatsApp and essential system functions, including Android Settings. You may still disable permissions, clear storage or uninstall through Android. Those actions can defeat on-device enforcement.

The server configuration is currently a personal preview. Public launch requires per-user authentication, recovery and the final hosted privacy policy.
